title: 格纹小绅士
prompt: Use case: a real photograph from a luxury pet fashion studio shoot, the kind a premium pet-apparel brand prints in a fashion magazine. Image 1 is the identity reference only, not a pose or background template. Keep the same young Miniature Schnauzer from Image 1, a fluffy puppy-like look with a soft round face, big round shiny dark eyes, a short fluffy white muzzle and soft white eyebrows, dark grey head top and ears with long silky fringes, salt-and-pepper grey-and-white fluffy coat and fluffy white legs; keep it just as sweet and adorable as in Image 1, but without its harness or collar. One pet only, no people, no hands. Set, garment and moment: A warm menswear-inspired fashion editorial on a deep forest-green painted backdrop, the arm of a worn cognac leather club chair and a small stack of two hardcover books beside the dog. The Miniature Schnauzer puppy sits upright on the floor in a natural dog pose, head tilted very slightly, big round dark eyes looking sweetly and proudly into the camera, mouth closed, fluffy eyebrows and muzzle softly groomed: polite, adorable and a little dignified. It wears a real red-and-green tartan wool dog coat made for small dogs: it covers its back and chest, its front legs come through the openings, it fastens with a strap under the chest and has a small brown corduroy collar at the neck. One large soft key light from camera left, rich warm tones. The garment is a real piece of pet clothing sewn for this animal's body shape, the kind actually sold for pets and put on a real dog or cat for a shoot: it wraps the animal's own back, chest and neck, the legs come out of it naturally, the fabric sits with believable weight, small folds and slight bunching where the body bends, and fur pokes out at the edges. The pet keeps its real animal anatomy, proportions and posture; it is clearly an animal wearing pet clothes, not a person. Photographic qualities: one dominant key light with natural falloff, true-to-life fur with individual strands, realistic eye moisture with one catchlight, believable contact shadow on the floor or seat. Medium-format camera, 85-100mm lens at about f/4, refined magazine colour grading, mild contrast, fine grain, no plastic retouching. Attitude: noble, poised and a little aloof, a calm self-assured gaze, so any owner would want this shot of their own pet. Indoor studio only. Framing: Three-quarter to full body: the pet sits or stands in its own natural animal posture at about 55-70% of frame height, so the pet-cut garment is clearly worn on an animal's body, with the set piece partly visible beside it. Avoid: anthropomorphic dressing, a human torso or human shoulders, an upright human-like posture, human dress shirts, shirt collars, neckties, suit lapels on a human-shaped chest, clothes that look painted or pasted onto the fur, a head pasted on a costume, cartoonish costumes, crowns, extra accessories, cluttered sets, outdoor scenery, glowing rim light, oversaturated colours, perfect symmetry, extra limbs, duplicate pets, CGI or illustration look, text, logos or watermark. Return one photograph only.
